title: Tam Ryvora
description: Colossus mechanic Tam Ryvora dreamed of being a pilot. She developed a strong friendship with Kazuda Xiono and felt betrayed when she discovered that he was a Resistance spy. Tam subsequently joined the First Order, and got the chance to be a TIE fighter pilot. However, over time she became disillusioned with the First Order, and took serious measures to rejoin her friends.
